# meok-w3c-tdm-rights-mcp

> MEOK W3C TDM Rights MCP — EU CDSM Directive Article 4(3) Text + Data Mining opt-out. Issues + scans HTTP/HTML/robots.txt/C2PA reservation signals. Liability shield for AI training pipelines. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- issue_tdm_reservation
- scan_url_for_reservation
- verify_c2pa_do_not_train
- check_robots_txt
- generate_compliant_scraper_config
- sign_training_scan
- list_known_ai_agents

## Install
```
pip install meok-w3c-tdm-rights-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-w3c-tdm-rights-mcp/
